about: UnderCover's real disk use and download in GB, measured and rounded up. Disk: a real install with tests/installer_e2e.ps1 on 2026-10-18 (ROCm: .venv and uv's cache 6.4, tools 0.5, app 0.1) and the AI models setup installs, 8.75 (every file's size in core/setup_models.KNOWN_SIZES: separation 2.74, voice models 1.00, speaker 0.03, Kokoro 0.35, Chatterbox Turbo 2.99, Whisper 1.62). download_gb: what setup downloads with an AMD card, 11.4 (the ROCm PyTorch wheels 2.19, the pinned packages 0.23 matched on PyPI by their SHA-256, uv, Python, ffmpeg and Deno 0.2, the models 8.75). CUDA hasn't been measured: it is given ROCm's size. installer/space.ps1 adds the margin to the disk sizes. steps: what each long setup step adds to uv's cache, for its progress bar.
